headline: AI-Powered Full Stack Developer | Mobile, Web & LLM Engineering
summary: Full Stack Developer with 8 years of production experience in React Native, Node.js, and React, now expanding into AI engineering and automation. Hands-on with Claude Code, Cursor AI, OpenAI API, TensorFlow, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations for AI-assisted development and on-device inference. Background spans REST API architecture, microservices, and cloud deployment across AWS, Azure, and Firebase, with a focus on LLM applications, AI agents, and workflow automation for production systems.

experience.description: Build and maintain production React Native and Node.js applications across fintech, food-tech, and sports-tech products.
bullet_points: Build and maintain production React Native and Node.js applications across fintech, food-tech, and sports-tech products, serving live users on iOS, Android, and web.
Use Claude Code, Cursor AI, and MCP integrations in daily development for AI-assisted code generation, debugging, and code review, cutting feature turnaround time.
Develop a real-time AI mobile platform with OpenAI integration and ONNX Runtime on-device inference for wearable devices, tuning performance on constrained hardware.
Design REST API and microservices architecture across Node.js, Ruby on Rails, and Python (Django, FastAPI) backends, deployed on AWS, Azure, and Firebase.
Delivered food delivery platform features in React Native, Node.js, and React, with MongoDB, GraphQL, Socket.IO, and Redux Toolkit powering real-time orders and chat.

experience.description: Led development of multiple mobile applications.
bullet_points: Led development of Dukan.pk (team of 10), Log.Fish, Deenee, and Ailaaj, covering payments, real-time notifications, and offline-first architecture with Realm and Firebase.
Developed cross-platform mobile applications in React Native and contributed to architecture decisions and code review.
Built native Android applications for POS and e-commerce products, including Zash Go and Qareeb Online Store.
